newsitem.title: USA: Chubb confirms considering sale of units.
newsitem.headline: Chubb confirms considering sale of units.

text.p: Chubb Corp said it has retained Goldman Sachs & Co to assist it in evaluating its strategic alternatives for its life insurance companies, including a possible sale or spinoff of the business.
Chubb also said it was considering a possible sale of some or all of the properties of its Bellemead Development Corp subsidiary.
Chubb's statement on Tuesday confirms comments made to analysts and investors in a private conference call late Thursday.

In a tape of the conference call that was later made available, Chubb chief executive Dean O'Hare said the life insurance and real estate businesses, which have a combined book value of about $1.2 billion, were not earning satisfactory returns.
Proceeds from a possible sale or spinoff of the business might be used to buy back share, make an acquisition in an overseas market, or expand its other businesses.
Chubb shares shot up about 12 percent on Friday. The shares closed down 1-1/8 to 49-7/8 on Monday.
